notes: Rewrote MockBackend::destroy_object to dispatch on O::TYPE_NAME explicitly: separate match arms for 'Principal' and 'ShareNotification' (operating on the correct map and incrementing the correct state counter), plus an explicit unsupported-type arm that returns BackendSetError::Other(MockError(...)) loudly instead of falling through to a generic NotFound. The unknown-account path is hoisted out of the match for early-return.
title: MockBackend::destroy_object dispatches across notifications and principals maps in one body
